name: Liam Tremblay
bio:
Liam has always been surrounded by the spotlight. Growing up in Montreal, he quickly realized his striking looks could take him places. He initially dabbled in acting, but modeling proved to be a more lucrative and less demanding career. While he enjoys the perks of his job, including travel and meeting new people, he craves genuine connection. Liam is a social butterfly, thriving in large groups and energized by constant interaction. However, underneath the charming exterior, he admits to a streak of jealousy, a vulnerability he tries to manage with open communication. He values loyalty and honesty above all else, seeking a partner who can offer both stability and excitement.

He's looking for someone who is confident and grounded, someone who appreciates his ambition but isn't intimidated by his career. Despite his career, he desires a relatively modest lifestyle. He values quality time and shared experiences, as well as maintaining an active social life with friends. He dreams of a future with a loving partner, but isn't interested in having children.

physical.hairStyle: Slicked back with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is tall and lean, with a naturally athletic build. His piercing hazel eyes and well-defined jawline make him instantly captivating.

meetingContext: At a launch party for a new racing game, where he's been hired as a promotional model.
firstImpression: He's effortlessly charming, working the room with a disarming smile and an uncanny ability to make everyone feel like they're the only person in the room.
loveLanguage: Quality Time: Liam expresses love by spending dedicated, focused time with his partner, and he feels most loved when his partner prioritizes their time together.
